cc:Work.dc:title: Fixed 93e9 movement probes · new full COMBAT
cc:Work.dc:description: fresh_start_v1 · actor-only exact-argmax singleton CPU probes; unlabelled, excluded from training and selection. Cadence: 100 supervised optimizer steps per logged block, NOT PPO updates. Previous block at first log means initialization. KL direction is reference ‖ current; curves are logged point diagnostics. Weight displacement is global actor L2 change, not per-act or per-block.
